title: Exploration via Exploitation: The Blessing of Reward Diversity in Personalized Federated RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.12964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While federated reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally guaranteed high efficiency in homogeneous environments, collaboration is often hindered when agents possess distinct goals. In this paper, we flip this paradigm, framing reward heterogeneity not as a hurdle to consensus, but as a structural asset that catalyzes exploration. We first propose Personalized Federated Upper Confidence Bound Value Iteration (PF-UCBVI), which achieves optimal linear speedup by decoupling shared dynamics from personalized objectives. To eliminate the risks of explicit exploration, we then introduce Personalized Federated Exploration-Free Value Iteration (PF-EFVI), a purely greedy algorithm that leverages reward diversity to ensure state-action coverage. We prove that PF-EFVI attains logarithmic regret without explicit exploration bonuses under sufficient reward diversity. translated_title: 通过利用实现探索：个性化联邦强化学习中奖励多样性的福音
translated_abstract: 尽管联邦强化学习（RL）传统上在同质环境中能够保证高效率，但当智能体拥有各自不同的目标时，协作往往会受到阻碍。在本文中，我们颠覆了这一范式，将奖励异质性不再视为达成共识的障碍，而是视为能够催化探索的结构性资产。我们首先提出个性化联邦上置信界值迭代（PF-UCBVI），通过将共享动力学与个性化目标解耦，实现了最优的线性加速。为消除显式探索带来的风险，我们随后提出个性化联邦无探索值迭代（PF-EFVI），这是一种纯贪心算法，利用奖励多样性来确保状态-动作覆盖。我们证明，在足够的奖励多样性条件下，PF-EFVI无需显式探索奖励即可实现对数遗憾。我们的结果表明，智能体之间的分歧将探索负担从算法转移到了（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文将个性化联邦强化学习中的奖励异质性从协作障碍转变为结构性优势，提出PF-UCBVI和PF-EFVI算法，证明奖励多样性可替代显式探索，使纯贪心算法即可实现对数遗憾和最优线性加速。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes reward heterogeneity in personalized federated RL from a collaboration obstacle into a structural asset, proposing PF-UCBVI and PF-EFVI algorithms that prove reward diversity can substitute for explicit exploration, enabling a purely greedy algorithm to achieve logarithmic regret and optimal linear speedup.
